summary.ru: Королевство Кент — одно из семи королевств так называемой англосаксонской гептархии, основанное ютами в Юго-Восточной Англии.
summary.en: The Kingdom of the Kentish, today referred to as the Kingdom of Kent, was an early medieval English kingdom in present-day South East England. It existed from either the fifth or the sixth century AD until it was fully absorbed into the Kingdom of Wessex in the mid-9th century and later into the Kingdom of England in the early 10th century.
